title: Hilton Offers New Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype Designed to Provide Higher Energy Efficiency, Lower Utility Costs and a More Sustainable Stay for Guests
summary: Hilton announced the new Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype, now available to hotel owners and developers at scale.

0:00


The optional prototype is now available to hotel owners and developers at scale, providing a turnkey path toward reduced operational energy costs and environmental impact while maintaining the same reliable Home2 Suites by Hilton guest experience


- **Hilton has introduced the Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype** , an optional, scalable hotel design concept that combines all-electric systems, renewable energy and high-efficiency building technologies to help owners lower operating costs, reduce carbon emissions and build more resilient hotel assets.
- **The Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype is designed to deliver measurable owner value** , with energy modeling indicating potential annual energy cost reductions of 18% to 40%, approximately 30% greater energy efficiency and significant emissions reductions compared to a traditional Home2 Suites prototype.
- **Hilton developed the prototype to address rising hotel operating costs and evolving energy markets** , providing owners and developers with a turnkey option that supports long-term asset performance while maintaining the consistent guest experience associated with the Home2 Suites brand.
- **The Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype represents Hilton’s most sustainable prototype offering to date** , aligning with zero operational emissions building requirements established by the World Green Building Council, advancing Hilton’s Travel with Purpose strategy.
- **The Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype highlights Hilton’s broader approach to helping hotel owners improve efficiency and manage energy costs** , including support from Hilton Supply Management’s energy procurement program, which provides renewable energy sourcing, procurement expertise and cost-management solutions across Hilton’s global network.


**NEW YORK** – Hilton (NYSE: HLT) today announced the availability of the new Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype, an optional, turnkey offering for U.S. hotel owners and developers designed to lower operational energy costs and reduce carbon emissions while preserving the award-winning Home2 Suites guest experience. With U.S. hotel utility costs rising 28% over the past five years[according to the American Hotel & Lodging Association](https://www.ahla.com/sites/default/files/State-of-the-Industry_2026_One-Pager.pdf) , the Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype was developed in response to evolving energy markets and growing industry demand for scalable, practical sustainability solutions. This new offering is Hilton’s first prototype designed with zero operational emissions to be made widely available to hotel owners and developers.


## Designed to Help Owners Reduce Costs and Emissions


With more than 9,400 hotels operating around the world, Hilton is helping owners design, build and operate more resilient, sustainable properties through efficient hotel design, operational best practices and technology innovation, aligned with its[Travel with Purpose](http://travelwithpurpose.hilton.com/) strategy. The Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype is Hilton’s most energy-efficient hotel design package that combines all-electric systems, on-site and off-site renewable energy and an enhanced building envelope to reduce operational energy costs for owners while creating a stronger return on investment over the life of the property (compared with a traditional Home2 Suites prototype.)


Based on a modeling analysis conducted across 13 U.S. cities, the design is expected to:


- increase energy efficiency by 30%;
- support increased property valuation;
- reduce annual energy costs by 18–40%; and
- reduce operational carbon emissions by 440 metric tons.*


**Dependent on market conditions and compared to a traditional Home2 Suites prototype model utilizing traditional energy sources like natural gas or nonrenewable grid-sourced electricity.*


“At Hilton, we know that sustainability solutions are most impactful when they are scalable, practical and make strong business sense to help power the future of responsible travel,” said Jean Garris Hand, vice president and global head, Sustainability & Responsible Business, Hilton. “Our owners, many of whom operate small businesses are facing rising energy costs and are looking for a turnkey option to lower operating expenses, improve energy efficiency and reduce emissions. With the Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype, Hilton is working to demonstrate that sustainable innovation can also be a driver of long-term business value.”


## Building on Home2 Suites by Hilton’s Legacy of Efficient Design


-


Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype - Solar Panels


-


Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype - EV Charging


Built around the needs of extended stay travelers and its efficient approach to hotel design, Home2 Suites has a strong track record of[pioneering](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/home2-suites-by-hilton-an-incubator-of-innovation-and-hospitality) innovations that create lasting value for owners and guests.


The brand's flexible prototype and innovative spirit make it uniquely positioned to test and scale solutions that enhance performance across the hotel lifecycle, from construction to operational building systems. Home2 Suites provides owners with more sustainable choices by integrating intentional prototype designs made to reduce energy use, conserve water and support more efficient operations. These include energy-efficient building design and roofing materials, water-conscious landscaping, ENERGY STAR-rated appliances, saline pools, reusable dishware, LED lighting and other features. Together, these features support the reliable, comfortable extended-stay experience guests expect from Home2 Suites while helping owners operate more efficiently and responsibly.


As sustainability continues to influence travel decisions, these efforts also resonate with guests, more than half of whom say preserving resources for future generations is important to them. As the hotel brand with the largest development pipeline in the U.S., Home2 Suites offers a meaningful opportunity to introduce the next generation of sustainable hotel design at scale.


“Since its launch, Home2 Suites has been built on a foundation of innovation, efficient solutions and flexible design. That innovative spirit remains at the core of the brand today, shaping everything from our flexible prototype and operational efficiencies to the amenities and experiences designed for extended stay travelers. This optional prototype represents the natural next step in that commitment,” said Talene Staab, brand leader, Home2 Suites by Hilton. “As the brand continues to grow across the country, Home2 Suites gives Hilton a powerful platform and opportunity to lead a forward-looking solution that can help owners reduce energy use and operating costs at scale, while continuing to deliver the reliable, extended stay experience guests know and love.”


## Expanding Energy Cost Savings for Owners


Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype - Exterior Midday


Beyond the Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype, Hilton continues to explore additional ways to apply these solutions across different markets, operating environments and owner needs. For example, Hilton’s procurement arm, Hilton Supply Management, continues to expand its energy procurement program that helps hotels manage energy costs, improve budget predictability and evaluate renewable and lower-carbon energy options where available. In 2025, the program helped participating owners save approximately 17% on their energy costs and avoided more than 102,130 metric tons of CO₂ while supporting more sustainable operations and lower energy costs.


##### FAQ: Hilton Offers New Home2 Suites by Hilton Clean Energy Prototype Designed to Provide Higher Energy Efficiency, Lower Utility Costs and a More Sustainable Stay for Guests


Hilton is announcing the Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype, an optional, turnkey, scalable property concept for hotel developers and owners that is designed to support a highly energy-efficient hotel with lower operating costs, reduced environmental impact and the same reliable stay guests expect from Home2 Suites.


No. This is not a mandatory prototype. This is an optional prototype available for developers and owners who are interested in building a highly energy-efficient hotel with lower operating costs and reduced environmental impact.


With more than 9,400 hotels around the world operating in a variable energy market, Hilton is focused on scalable solutions that help owners use less energy, reduce operating costs and create more predictable and resilient long-term value. The Home2 Suites Clean Energy Prototype demonstrates how sustainable progress can work in the real world: lowering energy use and emissions while supporting a stronger business case for owners, investors, communities and travelers alike. It also builds on Home2 Suites’ position as the hotel brand with the largest pipeline in the U.S.

## About Travel with Purpose


Guided by its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton believes that travel can be a powerful force for good. That belief comes to life through Travel with Purpose, Hilton’s strategy to drive positive impact and deliver lasting value to the people, guests, hotels and communities where we all live, work and stay. Travel with Purpose is good for business—it enables Hilton to unlock doors of opportunity for our people, create more sustainable stays in our hotels that our guests can feel good about and build the resilience of our communities while operating responsibly. Since 2022, Hilton has created more than 3.1 million learning and career growth opportunities, reduced carbon emissions and water use across its global portfolio and meaningfully impacted over 9.6 million community members through strategic investments, volunteerism and philanthropic partnerships. We track, analyze and report the impact of Hilton’s portfolio of hotels through LightStay, our industry-leading environmental and community impact management platform. Learn more about Travel with Purpose at[travelwithpurpose.hilton.com](https://travelwithpurpose.hilton.com/) .
